Mark it to distinguish it from procurement for construction. Maintenance cost and capital cost must not be mixed.

The total of %(t)s is below the %(n)s threshold, so no purchase requisition is needed — press Odoo's "Order" to raise a purchase order directly.\n\nThe threshold is changed in the system parameter "%(p)s".
Requisition "%s" is marked as buying maintenance spares, so it has to say which ASSET it is for, or at least which COMPONENT CATEGORY. Without that, maintenance cost cannot later be summed per asset.
